tasks.commitBody:
The season card header now leads with the season's NAME (the h2
keeps its element, slot and id — only the text changes to the
existing non-panel-gated seasonManageDeleteName derivation), with
the delete trashcan right after it, per Mihkel's live-gate reading
('Prügikast peaks olema hooaja nime taga hoopis'). The gear gains
its own aria-label so its accessible name still says what it does;
the panel keeps aria-labelledby — a region named by its season.

The trashcan now actually paints red: the 🗑 emoji resolved to the
platform colour-emoji font, which ignores CSS color — replaced by
a small reusable inline-SVG icon component on currentColor, tinted
by the existing text-red-700/hover classes. This is the #237 trial
instance: the component is defined once; the sweep spends it.

PO reading flagged on the issue (correctable at the live gate):
name-in-header rather than trashcan-into-panel, preserving the
collapsed-card delete reachability #236 bought.

Live gate (Mihkel, watching): header reads '2026/2027' + red
trashcan + [+ Hooaeg] + gear; trashcan is genuinely red on the
phone.
